title: AISimulate modeled-power metrics v1
description: Required, nullable modeled-power fields planned for replay reports and Sweeper candidate metrics, using AIC-compatible power and coverage semantics.
$comment: This schema formalizes field semantics; it does not add a runtime producer. JSON numbers are finite. Producers validating host-language objects must reject NaN and positive or negative infinity before serialization.

power_w.description: Active forward-pass average power per GPU in watts, or null when publication conditions are not met.

power_coverage.description: Fraction of modeled active latency with positive operation-energy evidence, weighted by latency rather than operation count; null when the required energy-aware path is unavailable.
